schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS installation(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))<=350000))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spaces(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clubs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,provider TEXT NOT NULL,native_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,logo TEXT,UNIQUE(provider,native_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,provider TEXT NOT NULL,native_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,club_id TEXT,season TEXT,archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(provider,native_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teams_name ON teams(name COLLATE NOCASE,id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS space_teams(space_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id),team_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id),role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('primary','connected','followed')),PRIMARY KEY(space_id,team_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connections(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,space_id TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id),provider TEXT NOT NULL,team_id TEXT,native_id TEXT,secret TEXT,options TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS connections_space ON connections(space_id,provider,active)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS identity_links(a TEXT NOT NULL,b TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(evidence AS BLOB))<=20000),observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(a,b))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS competitions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,provider TEXT NOT NULL,native_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',starts_on TEXT,ends_on TEXT,details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',observed_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS divisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,competition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES competitions(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',observed_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memberships(team_id TEXT NOT NULL,division_id TEXT NOT NULL,registration_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',evidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(team_id,division_id,registration_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_division ON memberships(division_id,team_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixtures(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,provider TEXT NOT NULL,native_id TEXT NOT NULL,competition_id TEXT,division_id TEXT,home_id TEXT,away_id TEXT,starts_at TEXT,local_day TEXT,type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'game',status TEXT NOT NULL,conditional INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,home_score REAL,away_score REAL,payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(payload AS BLOB))<=64000),observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS fixtures_division ON fixtures(division_id,starts_at,id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_fixtures(team_id TEXT NOT NULL,fixture_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fixtures(id),starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(team_id,fixture_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS team_fixtures_time ON team_fixtures(team_id,starts_at,fixture_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS standings(division_id TEXT NOT NULL,pool_id TEXT NOT NULL,team_id TEXT NOT NULL,rank INTEGER,payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(payload AS BLOB))<=16000),scan_id TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(division_id,pool_id,team_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS players(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,provider TEXT NOT NULL,native_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,jersey TEXT,details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',observed_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_players(team_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,scan_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',PRIMARY KEY(team_id,player_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance(fixture_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(fixture_id,player_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,provider TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,connection_id TEXT,args TEXT NOT NULL,cursor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',next_at INTEGER NOT NULL,lease_token TEXT,lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_attempt TEXT,last_retrieved TEXT,last_saved TEXT,last_complete TEXT,last_error TEXT,scan_id TEXT NOT NULL,pages INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,rows_saved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,coverage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uncollected',interval_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_due ON jobs(next_at,id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,space_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_interests(subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscriptions(id),job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id),PRIMARY KEY(subscription_id,job_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS interests_job ON job_interests(job_id,subscription_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scan_rows(job_id TEXT NOT NULL,scan_id TEXT NOT NULL,record_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(job_id,scan_id,record_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS scan_rows_generation ON scan_rows(scan_id,job_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commit_fences(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,token TEXT NOT NULL,committed_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,job_id TEXT NOT NULL,scan_id TEXT NOT NULL,endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,params TEXT NOT NULL,at TEXT NOT NULL,status INTEGER,rows_count INTEGER,bytes INTEGER,hash TEXT,error TEXT)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS observations_job ON observations(job_id,at DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS observations_time ON observations(at,id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conflicts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,fixture_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,previous TEXT NOT NULL,incoming TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS conflicts_fixture ON conflicts(fixture_id,resolved)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favorites(space_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('team','fixture')),entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(space_id,kind,entity_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS corrections(space_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,season TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))<=32000),revision INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(space_id,kind,entity_id,season))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shares(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,space_id TEXT NOT NULL,token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coach_profiles(space_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,season TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(space_id,player_id,season))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coach_sessions(space_id TEXT NOT NULL,fixture_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))<=200000),revision INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(space_id,fixture_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trace_parts(fixture_id TEXT NOT NULL,team_id TEXT NOT NULL,part TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))<=1000000),observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(fixture_id,team_id,part))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trace_stats(fixture_id TEXT NOT NULL,team_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,period TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))<=512000),state TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(fixture_id,team_id,player_id,period))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS references_data(team_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))<=16000),observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(team_id,kind,id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_pending(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rate_limits(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,hits INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
